text.tspan: Step 4- Story: Making Numbers Come Alive (9)
“And now for 9,” said Mistress Creola. “I’ll write it.”
After she had drawn 9, she explained, “I drew a smile
because I’m so happy with how hard you all are working
and how well you are doing.”
Suddenly the class door opened again. This time it was
Ameer and Ameerah with the Nurse Crumpler. The twins
both had a look of shame on their faces.
